referenceSources.description:
A striking red Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution WRC car, bearing Marlboro branding and white alloy wheels, navigates a narrow mountain tarmac stage. The aerodynamic body kit, roof scoop, and large rear wing underscore its rally-spec design. Two helmeted crew members are visible inside, emphasizing its competitive use.

This image appears on Mitsubishi Motors’ Japanese motorsports webpage, which chronicles the brand’s World Rally Championship history. The site notes Mitsubishi’s WRC debut in 1973 and celebrates the Lancer Evolution’s championship successes from 1996 to 1999. The 2002 model shown here represents the marque’s continued rally heritage.
